b.sound: There was only one type of dinosaur.
About 900 different types of dinosaurs existed.

feedback.finish: Some dinosaur species lived together in herds, while others lived alone.

hint.text: The Tyrannosaurus rex is commonly called a T-Rex.

atoms.b: One of the most well-known species of ((++dinosaur dragon)) is the Tyrannosaurus Rex.
The Tyrannosaurus Rex had ((++short long)) arms but was tall and could grow up to 13 metres long! It could also weigh up to 6 tonnes.
As it ate other dinosaurs, the Tyrannosaurus Rex was a ((++carnivore herbivore)). In order to catch its prey, the T-Rex had to be very ((++fast slow)).

instruction.text: Complete this dinosaur’s profile by matching the descriptions to the right category.

atoms.b: The Brachiosaurus was one of the ((++largest smallest)) creatures that has ever lived on Earth.
It weighed up to ((++28_tonnes 28_grams)) and was about 25 metres long.
The Brachiosaurus was a herbivore and ate up to 200kg of ((++plants meat)) every day. The bigger it was, the ((++less_likely more_likely)) it was to be harmed by carnivorous predators.

atoms.b: The Stegosaurus could grow as long as ((++9_metres 9_centimetres)) and weighed up to 5 tonnes.
It was a herbivore and had to defend itself against ((++predators prey)).
To do this, it had ((++dangerous harmless)) spikes on the end of its tail. On its ((++back stomach)), it also had jagged bone plates.
